name: Return Reservation V 08
definition: Scope|The ReturnReservation message is sent by the transaction administrator to a member.|It is used to provide information on the details of one or more reservation facilities set by the member and managed by the transaction administrator.|The ReturnReservation message can be sent as a response to a related Get Reservation message (pull mode) or initiated by the transaction administrator (push mode). The push of information can take place either at prearranged times or as a warning or alarm when a problem has occurred.|Usage|At any time during the operating hours of the system, the member can query the transaction administrator to get information about the reservations facilities that the transaction administrator manages for the member.|The transaction administrator will send reservations information to the member based on the following elements:|- identification of the system|- identification of the account|- status of the reservation (default and/or current )|- type of reservation.
